rationale: AEP Ohio Transmission Company, Inc. is a distinct Ohio/FERC-regulated transmission operating company. Midwest Transmission Holdings directly owns it; AEP retains 80.1% of Midwest and the KKR/PSP 50/50 Olympus partnership owns 19.9%, producing 9.95% look-through interests for KKR and PSP from the June 5, 2025 closing.
recommendedChanges: Create one canonical AEP Ohio Transmission Company, Inc. company and retain AEP Indiana Michigan Transmission Company as a separate PortCo.
Record AEP as an active 80.1% look-through owner from the June 5, 2025 closing.
Record KKR and PSP Investments as active 9.95% look-through co-owners through Olympus BidCo L.P. from June 5, 2025.
Preserve Midwest Transmission Holdings as the 100% direct shareholder and the December 30, 2024 internal reorganization; do not count Midwest or Olympus as separate PortCos.
Treat Infra-PSP Canada Inc. as a PSP equity-commitment affiliate/vehicle, not as a disclosed fund; PSP's fund/account remains not publicly disclosed.
unresolvedQuestions: The exact EC25-47-000 authorization date and CFIUS clearance date were not located.
Internal KKR fund allocation and PSP account allocation are not publicly disclosed.
